fields.title: Ennyimba Entukuvu ez'Abaana
fields.subtitle: Ezaawandiikibwa mu lulimi olwangu, okukozesebwa abaana
fields.description: Kitaawe w'ennyimba z'Ekikristaayo ez'Olungereza yawandiika ennyimba zino entono mu 1715 abaana abato ennyo basobole okuyimba amazima amakulu ag'okukkiriza mu bigambo ebyangu ennyo. Okutendereza n'obutonde, okwagala kwa Katonda, obumpi bw'obulamu, ekisa n'obwesimbu, awamu n'ekibi ky'obugayaavu — byonna byateekebwa mu nnyimba ennyangu omwana z'ayinza okuyiga n'azikwata ku mutima. Okumala emyaka egisukka mu kikumi, ze zaali ennyimba ezaayigibwa okusinga mu lulimi Olungereza; "How doth the little busy bee" ne "'Tis the voice of the sluggard" byatandikira wano.
fields.attribution: Mu ttaka ly'olukale — Ennyimba Entukuvu za Isaac Watts (1715); ebigambo biva mu Project Gutenberg (ekitabo 13439). Ennyimba Entukuvu 28 zategekeddwa mu ssuula bbiri ez'okusoma, era ne zeeyongerwako Ennyimba ez'Empisa bbiri eza Watts ez'ennono; ebigambo tebyakyusibwa.

fields.title: Ennyimba Entukuvu, Ekitundu Ekisooka
fields.body_html:
Oluyimba Olwa Bulijjo olw'Okutendereza Katonda

1 Nga Kabaka waffe ow'omu ggulu wa kitiibwa,
Afuga waggulu w'eggulu!
Omwana anaayinza atya okuyimba
obukulu bwe obw'entiisa?

2 Amaanyi ge nga manene, tewali ayinza kubyogera,
wadde okulowooza ekisa kye nga kinene;
si bantu wansi, wadde abatukuvu ababeera
waggulu mu maaso ge.

3 Newaakubadde bamalayika abayimirira okwetooloola Mukama
tebayinza kunoonyereza ku byekubira bye eby'ekyama;
naye batuukiriza ekigambo kye eky'omu ggulu,
era beeyongera okumutendereza.

4 Kale nzikirize okwegatta ku kibiina kino ekitukuvu,
n'okuleeta ebiweebwayo byange ebisooka;
Katonda ataggwaawo tajja kunyooma
kuwulira omwana omuto ng'ayimba.

5 Omutima gwange gumaliridde, olulimi lwange lugondera,
era bamalayika balisanyuka
okuwulira ettendo ery'Omutonzi waabwe ow'amaanyi
nga livudde mu ddoboozi eddefu.

Okutendereza olw'Okutonda n'Okulabirira

1 Nyimba amaanyi ga Katonda ag'ekitalo,
agaakola ensozi ne zivaayo,
agaayanjuluza ennyanja ezikulukuta,
ne gazimba eggulu erya waggulu.

2 Nyimba amagezi agaalagira
enjuba okufuga obudde obw'emisana;
omwezi gwaka mujjuvu ku kiragiro kye,
n'emmunyeenye zonna zigondera.

3 Nyimba obulungi bwa Mukama,
obwajjuza ensi emmere;
yakola ebitonde n'ekigambo kye,
n'oluvannyuma n'abyogera nti birungi.

4 Mukama, eby'amagero byo nga bwe byolesebwa
buli we nkyusa eriiso lyange,
bwe ntunuulira ettaka lye nninnyako,
oba bwe nnyimusa amaaso mu ggulu.

5 Tewali kimera wadde ekimuli wansi
wabula kirangirira ekitiibwa kyo;
n'ebire biyimuka n'omuyaga gukunta
ku kiragiro okuva ku ntebe yo ey'obwakabaka.

6 Ebitonde (ne bwe biba bingi bwe bityo)
biri wansi w'okulabirira kwo:
tewali kifo gye tuyinza okuddukira,
wabula Katonda aliyo eyo.

7 Mu ggulu ayakaayakana n'emisana gy'okwagala,
n'obusungu mu muliro wansi:
ku nsi ye kwe nnyimirira oba kwe ntambulira,
era mpeeza empewo ye.

8 Omukono gwe gwe mukuumi wange ow'olubeerera,
ankuuma n'eriiso lye:
kale lwaki nnandyerabidde Mukama
ali kumpi ennaku zonna?

Okutendereza Katonda olw'Okununulibwa kwaffe

1 Amagezi n'amaanyi bibe n'omukisa,
obwenkanya n'ekisa,
ebyegatta mu kuteesa okuzza obuggya
n'okulokola oluggya lwaffe olwazikirira!

2 Kitaffe yalya ekibala ekyaziyizibwa,
n'agwa okuva mu kitiibwa kye;
naffe, abaana be, bwe tutyo twaleetebwa
mu kufa, era okumpi n'omuliro.

3 Mukama abe n'omukisa, eyatuma Omwana we
okutwala omubiri gwaffe n'omusaayi;
yawaayo obulamu bwe ku lw'obulamu bwaffe,
okututeesaganya ne Katonda.

4 Yassaamu ekitiibwa amateeka gonna aga Kitaawe,
ge twajeemera;
yeetikka ebibi byaffe ku musaalaba,
n'asasula omutango gwaffe gwonna.

5 Mulabe ng'azuukira okuva mu ntaana;
mulabe ng'ayimusibwa waggulu:
awolereza ebirungi bye eyo okulokola
aboonoonyi abasaliddwa okufa.

6 Eyo ku ntebe ey'ekitiibwa, y'afuga,
era n'amaanyi ge ag'obwakatonda
atununula okuva mu njegere ez'obuddu
eza Setaani, n'ez'ekibi.

7 Okuva eyo Mukama alijja okusala omusango,
era, n'eddoboozi ery'obuyinza,
aliyita, n'amenya buli ntaana,
nga abatukuvu abazuukuka basanyuka.

8 Ayi, olwo nsobole okulabika n'essanyu
mu maaso g'Omulamuzi,
era, n'ekibiina ekyaweebwa omukisa eyo,
njimbe ekisa kye eky'okununula!

Okutendereza olw'Ebisa eby'Omwoyo n'eby'Omubiri

1 Buli lwe ntambula ebweru,
abaavu bameka be ndaba?
Kiki kye nnaawa Katonda wange
olw'ebirabo bye byonna by'ampadde?

2 Sisaanira kusinga balala,
naye Katonda ampadde ebisingawo;
kubanga nnina emmere, ng'abalala balumwa enjala,
oba basabiriza okuva ku luggi okutuuka ku luggi.

3 Abaana bameka mu nguudo
be ndaba nga bali bwereere?
ate nze nga nnyambaziddwa okuva ku mutwe okutuuka ku bigere,
era nga mbikkiddwa obutalumwa mpewo.

4 Ng'abamu abaavu abanaku tebamanyi bulungi
gye banaateeka omutwe gwabwe,
nze nnina amaka mwe mbeera,
era ne mpummulira ku kitanda kyange.

5 Ng'abalala bayiga amangu okulayira,
n'okukolima, n'okulimba, n'okubba,
Mukama, nze nnayigirizibwa okutya erinnya lyo,
n'okukola by'oyagala ebitukuvu.

6 Bino bye byakisa byo, buli lunaku
gye ndi okusinga abalala?
Kale nkwagale okusinga bo,
era nfube okukuweereza obulungi ennyo.

Okutendereza olw'Okuzaalibwa n'Okuyigirizibwa mu Nsi ey'Ekikristaayo

1 Katonda Omukulu, gy'oli nyimusa eddoboozi lyange,
gy'oli emirundi gyange egisooka mwe giri;
nnandyagadde okutandika obulamu bwange n'ettendo,
okutuusa emyaka nga gikula ne gyongera oluyimba.

2 Kisa kyo eky'obuyinza kye nnina okwebaza,
olw'okuzaalibwa ku ttaka ery'e Bungereza,
we emigga egy'okusaasira okw'omu ggulu gikulukutira,
n'ebigambo eby'obulokozi obuwoomerera we biwulikira.

3 Sandiwanyisizza nsi yange gye nnazaalibwamu
na Peru omugagga, ne zaabu ye yonna:
empeera ey'ekitiibwa esingako eri mu mukono gwange
okusinga India ez'ebuvanjuba oba ez'ebugwanjuba bye zirina.

4 Nga nsaasira abo ababeera
obutamanya n'ekizikiza gye bifuga;
tebamanyi ggulu, tebatya muliro,
essanyu eryo eritagwaawo, n'obulumi obwo obutakoma.

5 Ebisuubizo byo eby'ekitiibwa, Ayi Mukama,
bikoleeza essuubi lyange n'okwegomba kwange;
ng'ababuulizi bonna ab'ekigambo kyo
bandabula okudduka omuliro ogutaggwaawo.

6 Ettendo lyo linaakozesanga omukka gwange,
kubanga wateekawo ekkubo lyange erigenda mu ggulu;
so siriddukira kkubo eritwala mu kufa,
n'okwonoona emikisa gy'ompadde.

Okutendereza olw'Enjiri

1 Mukama, nkiwa ekisa kyo,
so si mukisa gwa bwereere nga bwe bakola abalala,
olw'okuzaalibwa mu luggya olw'Abakristaayo,
so si Omukaafiiri, oba Omuyudaaya.

2 Bakabaka Abayudaaya ab'edda kiki kye bandiwaddeyo,
ne bannabbi Abayudaaya kiki kye bandiwaddeyo,
singa baawulira ebintu bino eby'ekitiibwa,
Kristo bye yabikkula, n'abireeta okuva mu ggulu!

3 Abakaafiiri nga bandisanyuse nnyo,
abasinza ebifaananyi, embaawo, n'amayinja,
singa baalaba ekitabo kya Katonda,
oba okumanya Yesu n'enjiri ye!

4 Kale bwe nnaagaana Enjiri,
nnaayinza ntya okuyimusa amaaso gange?
kubanga Abamawanga bonna n'Abayudaaya
balinnyimukira mu kusala omusango.

Obusukkulumu bwa Baibuli

1 Katonda Omukulu, n'okwewuunya n'ettendo,
ku mirimu gyo gyonna nnyimusa amaaso;
naye amagezi go, amaanyi n'ekisa
byaka okusingira ddala mu Kitabo kyo.

2 Emmunyeenye eziwuluguuka mu makubo gaazo,
ziwaddeyo okuyigiriza kungi;
naye Ekigambo kyo ekirungi kimanyisa emmeeme yange
engeri gye nnaalinnyamu okutuuka mu ggulu.

3 Ennimiro zimpa emmere, era zooleka
obulungi bwa Mukama;
naye ebibala eby'obulamu n'ekitiibwa bimerera
mu Kigambo kyo ekitukuvu ennyo.

4 Wano we waliri eby'obugagga byange ebisinga okulondebwa,
wano we waliri okusanyusibwa kwange okusinga;
wano okwegomba kwange we kumatizibwa;
era okuva wano essuubi lyange we livira.

5 Mukama, ntegeeze etteeka lyo,
ndaga ensobi zange bwe zibadde;
era mu Njiri yo nkkirize okusena
okusonyiyibwa ebibi byange byonna.

6 Wano we nnandyagadde okuyiga Kristo nga bwe yafa
okulokola emmeeme yange okuva mu muliro:
n'ebitabo byonna ebirala eby'oku nsi
tebyogera byamagero bya ggulu bwe bityo.

7 Kale nnyongere okwagala Baibuli yange,
era neeyongere okusanyukira
emisana okusoma eby'amagero bino,
n'okubifumiitiriza ekiro.

Okutendereza Katonda olw'Okuyiga Okusoma

1 Ettendo ery'olulimi lwange
nnirwa Mukama,
olw'okuyigirizibwa, n'okuyiga nga nkyali muto
okusoma Ekigambo kye ekitukuvu.

2 Olw'okuyigirizibwa okumanya
akabi mwe nnali,
mu buzaale ne mu mpisa nazo
omuddu omunaku ow'ekibi.

3 Olw'okukulemberwa okulaba
nga siriiko kye nsobola kukola bulungi;
era omwonoonyi anadduka wa,
okwerokola okuva mu muliro?

4 Mukama omwagalwa, ekitabo kino ekikyo
kimmanyisa gye nnaagenda
okufuna ekisa okusonyiwa ebibi byange byonna,
n'okunfuula omutukuvu nange.

5 Wano we nsobola okusoma n'okuyiga
Kristo Omwana wa Katonda nga bwe
yeetikka ensonga yaffe enkulu,
yasasula omutango gwaffe n'omusaayi gwe.

6 Ne kaakati afuga waggulu,
asindika Omwoyo we wansi,
okwoleka eby'amagero eby'okwagala kwe,
n'okumanyisa Enjiri ye.

7 Ayi, Omwoyo oyo ayigirize,
era aleetere omutima gwange okukkiriza
amazima ago abaddu bo bonna ge babuulira,
n'abatukuvu bo bonna ge bakkiriza!

8 Kale ndyawa Mukama ettendo
mu ddoboozi erisanyusa okusingawo,
olw'okuyigirizibwa okusoma Ekigambo kye,
so nga saayiga bwereere.

Oluyimba 9. Katonda Alaba Byonna

1 Katonda Ayinzabyonna, eriiso lyo erifumita
likuba wakati mu bisiikirize eby'ekiro,
n'ebikolwa byaffe ebisinga okuba eby'ekyama biri
nga byonna byeyolese mu maaso go.

2 Tewali kibi kye tukola,
wadde ekigambo ekibi kye twogera,
wabula mu kitabo kyo eky'entiisa kiwandiikiddwa
okutuusa ku lunaku olw'omusango.

3 Era ebibi bye nnakola
binaasomebwa ne bimanyisibwa eyo,
byonna binaayanjululwa mu maaso g'enjuba,
nga abantu ne bamalayika bawulira?

4 Mukama, awali ebigere byo ngalamira nga nkwatiddwa ensonyi,
waggulu siyinza kutunula;
sonyiwa ebibi byange nga sinnafa,
era obisangule mu kitabo kyo.

5 Jjukira obulumi bwonna obw'okufa
Omununuzi wange bwe yawulira,
era omusaayi gwe gunaaze ebbala lyange,
era guvunaanibwe olw'omusango gwange.

6 Ayi, kaakati ntyenga ennaku zonna
okusembeza endowooza ey'ekibi,
kubanga Katonda omukulu asobola okulaba, n'okuwulira,
era awandiika buli nsobi!

Endowooza Enzito ku Katonda n'Okufa

1 Waliwo Katonda afuga waggulu,
Mukama w'eggulu, n'ensi, n'ennyanja:
ntya obusungu bwe, nsaba okwagala kwe,
era n'emimwa gyange nnyimba ettendo lye.

2 Waliwo etteeka lye yawandiika,
okutuyigiriza ffenna kye tuteekwa okukola;
emmeeme yange, gondera ebiragiro bye,
kubanga bitukuvu, bya bwenkanya era bya mazima.

3 Waliwo Enjiri ey'ekisa ekingi,
aboonoonyi mwe basena okusanyusibwa kwabwe kwonna;
Mukama, nneenenya, era nnoonya amaaso go;
kubanga emirundi mingi nnamenya etteeka lyo.

4 Waliwo essaawa lwe nnaafa,
so simanyi kaseera ki lw'erijja;
abaana lukumi abato nga nze
bayitibwa okufa okuwulira omusango gwabwe.

5 Nkozese obulungi essaawa ze nnina
nga olunaku olw'ekisa terunnaba kudduka;
tewali kwenenya mu ntaana,
tewali kusonyiyibwa kuweebwa abafu.

6 Nga omuti bwe gutemebwa, ne gugwa
mu bukiikakkono, oba mu bukiikaddyo, awo we gugalamira:
bw'atyo omuntu agenda mu ggulu oba mu muliro,
ng'anywezeddwa mu mbeera gy'afiiramu.

Eggulu n'Omuliro

1 Waliwo emitwe w'eggulu
eggulu ery'essanyu n'okwagala,
n'abaana abatukuvu, bwe bafa,
bagenda mu nsi eyo eya waggulu.

2 Waliwo omuliro ogw'entiisa,
n'obulumi obutaggwaawo,
eyo aboonoonyi kwe bateekwa okubeera ne baddayimooni
mu kizikiza, omuliro, n'enjegere.

3 Omunaku nga nze
ayinza okudduka enkomerero eno eyakolimirwa?
Era nnyinza okusuubira, buli lwe nnaafa,
nti ndirinnya mu ggulu?

4 Kale nnaasoma era nnaasaba
nga nkyalina obulamu n'omukka;
nneme okusalibwako leero,
ne nsindikibwa mu kufa okutaggwaawo.

Emigaso egy'Eddiini mu Buto

1 Alina omukisa omwana emyaka gye egisooka
gye gafuna okuyigirizibwa obulungi;
akyawa ekkubo ly'omwonoonyi, era atya
oluguudo olutwala mu muliro.

2 Bwe tuwaayo obuvubuka bwaffe eri Katonda,
kisanyusa mu maaso ge;
ekimuli, bwe kiweebwayo nga kikyali muto,
si kiweebwayo kya bwereere.

3 Mulimu mwangu bwe tutandika
okutya Mukama nga tukyali bato;
so ng'aboonoonyi abakadde mu kibi
bakakanyala mu bibi byabwe.

4 Kinaatulokola mu mitego olukumi
okussaayo omwoyo ku ddiini nga tukyali bato;
ekisa kinaakuuma emyaka gyaffe egiddirira
ne kinyweza empisa zaffe ennungi.

5 Gy'oli, Katonda Ayinzabyonna, gy'oli
obwana bwaffe tubuwaayo;
kinaatusanyusa okutunula emabega ne tulaba
nti obulamu bwaffe bwonna bwali bubwo.

6 Omulimu omuwoomerera ogw'okusaba n'okutendereza,
gukozese omukka gwange ogusooka;
bwe ntyo neetegeka olw'ennaku empanvu,
oba ne nsaanira okufa nga nkyali muto.

Akabi k'Okulwawo

1 Lwaki njogera nti, “Kikyali kyangu nnyo
“okunoonya eggulu oba okulowooza ku kufa?”
Ekimuli kiyinza okuwotoka nga essaawa ez'omu ttuntu tezinnatuuka,
nange leero nnyinza okufiirwa omukka gwange.

2 Omutima guno ogwange omujeemu,
bwe gunyooma okuyita okw'ekisa okw'Eggulu;
nnyinza okukakanyala mu kibi kyange,
ne siweebwa kwenenya n'akatono.

3 Singa Mukama asunguwala, n'alayira
nga nnyanukola okusoma n'okusaba,
nti anaagaana okuwuliriza,
okusinda kwange kwonna ku lunaku olulala?

4 Singa obusungu bwe obw'entiisa bwaka,
nga ngaana ekisa kye ky'awaayo,
n'okwagala kwe kwonna ne kufuuka obukambwe,
n'ankuba ne nfiira awo?

5 Kya kabi okusunguwaza Katonda;
amaanyi ge n'okuwoolera eggwanga tewali ayinza kubyogera:
okukuba kumu okw'oluga lwe olw'amaanyi
kunaasindika aboonoonyi abato mangu mu muliro.

6 Kale kinaaba kya bwereere emirembe gyonna
okukaabira okusonyiyibwa oba okufuna ekisa,
okwegomba nti nnandifunye ekiseera kyange nate,
oba okusuubira okulaba amaaso g'Omutonzi wange.

Eby'okulabirako eby'Okutya Katonda mu Buto

1 Eby'okulabirako ebya mukisa nga bimeka bye nsanga,
nga biwandiikiddwa mu Kigambo eky'Amazima,
eby'abaana abaatandika okussaayo omwoyo
ku ddiini nga bakyali bato.

2 Yesu, afuga waggulu w'eggulu,
era akuuma ensi mu ntiisa;
yali omwana omuto nga nze,
era yakuuma etteeka lya Kitaawe.

3 Ku myaka kkumi n'ebiri yayogera n'abasajja,
(Abayudaaya bonna nga bayimirira nga bawuniikiriddwa;)
naye n'agondera Nnyina mu kiseera ekyo,
n'ajja ku kiragiro kye.

4 Abaana baayimba ozana ewoomerera,
ne batendereza erinnya ly'Omulokozi waabwe;
baamuwa ekitiibwa n'olulimi lwabwe
ng'abawandiisi ne bakabona bavvoola.

5 Samwiri omwana yaggyibwa ku mabeere, n'aleetebwa
okuweereza Mukama;
Timoseewo omuto yayigirizibwa amangu
okumanya Ekigambo kye ekitukuvu.

6 Kale lwaki nnindiriza ekiseera ekiwanvu bwe kityo
ekyo abalala kye bayiga amangu?
sandiyisizza lunaku lulala
nga omulimu guno tegunnatandika.

Okutendereza Katonda olw'Okununulibwa kwaffe 1 Amagezi n'amaanyi bibe n'omukisa, obwenkanya n'ekisa, ebyegatta mu kuteesa okuzza obuggya n'okulokola oluggya lwaffe olwazikirira! 2 Kitaffe yalya ekibala ekyaziyizibwa, n'agwa okuva mu kitiibwa kye; naffe, abaana be, bwe tutyo twaleetebwa mu kufa, era okumpi n'omuliro. 3 Mukama abe n'omukisa, eyatuma Omwana we okutwala omubiri gwaffe n'omusaayi; yawaayo obulamu bwe ku lw'obulamu bwaffe, okututeesaganya ne Katonda. 4 Yassaamu ekitiibwa amateeka gonna aga Kitaawe, ge twajeemera; yeetikka ebibi byaffe ku musaalaba, n'asasula omutango gwaffe gwonna. 5 Mulabe ng'azuukira okuva mu ntaana; mulabe ng'ayimusibwa waggulu: awolereza ebirungi bye eyo okulokola aboonoonyi abasaliddwa okufa. 6 Eyo ku ntebe ey'ekitiibwa, y'afuga, era n'amaanyi ge ag'obwakatonda atununula okuva mu njegere ez'obuddu eza Setaani, n'ez'ekibi. 7 Okuva eyo Mukama alijja okusala omusango, era, n'eddoboozi ery'obuyinza, aliyita, n'amenya buli ntaana, nga abatukuvu abazuukuka basanyuka. 8 Ayi, olwo nsobole okulabika n'essanyu mu maaso g'Omulamuzi, era, n'ekibiina ekyaweebwa omukisa eyo, njimbe ekisa kye eky'okununula! Okutendereza olw'Ebisa eby'Omwoyo n'eby'Omubiri 1 Buli lwe ntambula ebweru, abaavu bameka be ndaba? Kiki kye nnaawa Katonda wange olw'ebirabo bye byonna by'ampadde? 2 Sisaanira kusinga balala, naye Katonda ampadde ebisingawo; kubanga nnina emmere, ng'abalala balumwa enjala, oba basabiriza okuva ku luggi okutuuka ku luggi. 3 Abaana bameka mu nguudo be ndaba nga bali bwereere? ate nze nga nnyambaziddwa okuva ku mutwe okutuuka ku bigere, era nga mbikkiddwa obutalumwa mpewo. 4 Ng'abamu abaavu abanaku tebamanyi bulungi gye banaateeka omutwe gwabwe, nze nnina amaka mwe mbeera, era ne mpummulira ku kitanda kyange. 5 Ng'abalala bayiga amangu okulayira, n'okukolima, n'okulimba, n'okubba, Mukama, nze nnayigirizibwa okutya erinnya lyo, n'okukola by'oyagala ebitukuvu. 6 Bino bye byakisa byo, buli lunaku gye ndi okusinga abalala? Kale nkwagale okusinga bo, era nfube okukuweereza obulungi ennyo. Okutendereza olw'Okuzaalibwa n'Okuyigirizibwa mu Nsi ey'Ekikristaayo 1 Katonda Omukulu, gy'oli nyimusa eddoboozi lyange, gy'oli emirundi gyange egisooka mwe giri; nnandyagadde okutandika obulamu bwange n'ettendo, okutuusa emyaka nga gikula ne gyongera oluyimba. 2 Kisa kyo eky'obuyinza kye nnina okwebaza, olw'okuzaalibwa ku ttaka ery'e Bungereza, we emigga egy'okusaasira okw'omu ggulu gikulukutira, n'ebigambo eby'obulokozi obuwoomerera we biwulikira. 3 Sandiwanyisizza nsi yange gye nnazaalibwamu na Peru omugagga, ne zaabu ye yonna: empeera ey'ekitiibwa esingako eri mu mukono gwange okusinga India ez'ebuvanjuba oba ez'ebugwanjuba bye zirina. 4 Nga nsaasira abo ababeera obutamanya n'ekizikiza gye bifuga; tebamanyi ggulu, tebatya muliro, essanyu eryo eritagwaawo, n'obulumi obwo obutakoma. 5 Ebisuubizo byo eby'ekitiibwa, Ayi Mukama, bikoleeza essuubi lyange n'okwegomba kwange; ng'ababuulizi bonna ab'ekigambo kyo bandabula okudduka omuliro ogutaggwaawo. 6 Ettendo lyo linaakozesanga omukka gwange, kubanga wateekawo ekkubo lyange erigenda mu ggulu; so siriddukira kkubo eritwala mu kufa, n'okwonoona emikisa gy'ompadde. Okutendereza olw'Enjiri 1 Mukama, nkiwa ekisa kyo, so si mukisa gwa bwereere nga bwe bakola abalala, olw'okuzaalibwa mu luggya olw'Abakristaayo, so si Omukaafiiri, oba Omuyudaaya. 2 Bakabaka Abayudaaya ab'edda kiki kye bandiwaddeyo, ne bannabbi Abayudaaya kiki kye bandiwaddeyo, singa baawulira ebintu bino eby'ekitiibwa, Kristo bye yabikkula, n'abireeta okuva mu ggulu! 3 Abakaafiiri nga bandisanyuse nnyo, abasinza ebifaananyi, embaawo, n'amayinja, singa baalaba ekitabo kya Katonda, oba okumanya Yesu n'enjiri ye! 4 Kale bwe nnaagaana Enjiri, nnaayinza ntya okuyimusa amaaso gange? kubanga Abamawanga bonna n'Abayudaaya balinnyimukira mu kusala omusango. Obusukkulumu bwa Baibuli 1 Katonda Omukulu, n'okwewuunya n'ettendo, ku mirimu gyo gyonna nnyimusa amaaso; naye amagezi go, amaanyi n'ekisa byaka okusingira ddala mu Kitabo kyo. 2 Emmunyeenye eziwuluguuka mu makubo gaazo, ziwaddeyo okuyigiriza kungi; naye Ekigambo kyo ekirungi kimanyisa emmeeme yange engeri gye nnaalinnyamu okutuuka mu ggulu. 3 Ennimiro zimpa emmere, era zooleka obulungi bwa Mukama; naye ebibala eby'obulamu n'ekitiibwa bimerera mu Kigambo kyo ekitukuvu ennyo. 4 Wano we waliri eby'obugagga byange ebisinga okulondebwa, wano we waliri okusanyusibwa kwange okusinga; wano okwegomba kwange we kumatizibwa; era okuva wano essuubi lyange we livira. 5 Mukama, ntegeeze etteeka lyo, ndaga ensobi zange bwe zibadde; era mu Njiri yo nkkirize okusena okusonyiyibwa ebibi byange byonna. 6 Wano we nnandyagadde okuyiga Kristo nga bwe yafa okulokola emmeeme yange okuva mu muliro: n'ebitabo byonna ebirala eby'oku nsi tebyogera byamagero bya ggulu bwe bityo. 7 Kale nnyongere okwagala Baibuli yange, era neeyongere okusanyukira emisana okusoma eby'amagero bino, n'okubifumiitiriza ekiro. Okutendereza Katonda olw'Okuyiga Okusoma 1 Ettendo ery'olulimi lwange nnirwa Mukama, olw'okuyigirizibwa, n'okuyiga nga nkyali muto okusoma Ekigambo kye ekitukuvu. 2 Olw'okuyigirizibwa okumanya akabi mwe nnali, mu buzaale ne mu mpisa nazo omuddu omunaku ow'ekibi. 3 Olw'okukulemberwa okulaba nga siriiko kye nsobola kukola bulungi; era omwonoonyi anadduka wa, okwerokola okuva mu muliro? 4 Mukama omwagalwa, ekitabo kino ekikyo kimmanyisa gye nnaagenda okufuna ekisa okusonyiwa ebibi byange byonna, n'okunfuula omutukuvu nange. 5 Wano we nsobola okusoma n'okuyiga Kristo Omwana wa Katonda nga bwe yeetikka ensonga yaffe enkulu, yasasula omutango gwaffe n'omusaayi gwe. 6 Ne kaakati afuga waggulu, asindika Omwoyo we wansi, okwoleka eby'amagero eby'okwagala kwe, n'okumanyisa Enjiri ye. 7 Ayi, Omwoyo oyo ayigirize, era aleetere omutima gwange okukkiriza amazima ago abaddu bo bonna ge babuulira, n'abatukuvu bo bonna ge bakkiriza! 8 Kale ndyawa Mukama ettendo mu ddoboozi erisanyusa okusingawo, olw'okuyigirizibwa okusoma Ekigambo kye, so nga saayiga bwereere. Oluyimba 9. Katonda Alaba Byonna 1 Katonda Ayinzabyonna, eriiso lyo erifumita likuba wakati mu bisiikirize eby'ekiro, n'ebikolwa byaffe ebisinga okuba eby'ekyama biri nga byonna byeyolese mu maaso go. 2 Tewali kibi kye tukola, wadde ekigambo ekibi kye twogera, wabula mu kitabo kyo eky'entiisa kiwandiikiddwa okutuusa ku lunaku olw'omusango. 3 Era ebibi bye nnakola binaasomebwa ne bimanyisibwa eyo, byonna binaayanjululwa mu maaso g'enjuba, nga abantu ne bamalayika bawulira? 4 Mukama, awali ebigere byo ngalamira nga nkwatiddwa ensonyi, waggulu siyinza kutunula; sonyiwa ebibi byange nga sinnafa, era obisangule mu kitabo kyo. 5 Jjukira obulumi bwonna obw'okufa Omununuzi wange bwe yawulira, era omusaayi gwe gunaaze ebbala lyange, era guvunaanibwe olw'omusango gwange. 6 Ayi, kaakati ntyenga ennaku zonna okusembeza endowooza ey'ekibi, kubanga Katonda omukulu asobola okulaba, n'okuwulira, era awandiika buli nsobi! Endowooza Enzito ku Katonda n'Okufa 1 Waliwo Katonda afuga waggulu, Mukama w'eggulu, n'ensi, n'ennyanja: ntya obusungu bwe, nsaba okwagala kwe, era n'emimwa gyange nnyimba ettendo lye. 2 Waliwo etteeka lye yawandiika, okutuyigiriza ffenna kye tuteekwa okukola; emmeeme yange, gondera ebiragiro bye, kubanga bitukuvu, bya bwenkanya era bya mazima. 3 Waliwo Enjiri ey'ekisa ekingi, aboonoonyi mwe basena okusanyusibwa kwabwe kwonna; Mukama, nneenenya, era nnoonya amaaso go; kubanga emirundi mingi nnamenya etteeka lyo. 4 Waliwo essaawa lwe nnaafa, so simanyi kaseera ki lw'erijja; abaana lukumi abato nga nze bayitibwa okufa okuwulira omusango gwabwe. 5 Nkozese obulungi essaawa ze nnina nga olunaku olw'ekisa terunnaba kudduka; tewali kwenenya mu ntaana, tewali kusonyiyibwa kuweebwa abafu. 6 Nga omuti bwe gutemebwa, ne gugwa mu bukiikakkono, oba mu bukiikaddyo, awo we gugalamira: bw'atyo omuntu agenda mu ggulu oba mu muliro, ng'anywezeddwa mu mbeera gy'afiiramu. Eggulu n'Omuliro 1 Waliwo emitwe w'eggulu eggulu ery'essanyu n'okwagala, n'abaana abatukuvu, bwe bafa, bagenda mu nsi eyo eya waggulu. 2 Waliwo omuliro ogw'entiisa, n'obulumi obutaggwaawo, eyo aboonoonyi kwe bateekwa okubeera ne baddayimooni mu kizikiza, omuliro, n'enjegere. 3 Omunaku nga nze ayinza okudduka enkomerero eno eyakolimirwa? Era nnyinza okusuubira, buli lwe nnaafa, nti ndirinnya mu ggulu? 4 Kale nnaasoma era nnaasaba nga nkyalina obulamu n'omukka; nneme okusalibwako leero, ne nsindikibwa mu kufa okutaggwaawo. Emigaso egy'Eddiini mu Buto 1 Alina omukisa omwana emyaka gye egisooka gye gafuna okuyigirizibwa obulungi; akyawa ekkubo ly'omwonoonyi, era atya oluguudo olutwala mu muliro. 2 Bwe tuwaayo obuvubuka bwaffe eri Katonda, kisanyusa mu maaso ge; ekimuli, bwe kiweebwayo nga kikyali muto, si kiweebwayo kya bwereere. 3 Mulimu mwangu bwe tutandika okutya Mukama nga tukyali bato; so ng'aboonoonyi abakadde mu kibi bakakanyala mu bibi byabwe. 4 Kinaatulokola mu mitego olukumi okussaayo omwoyo ku ddiini nga tukyali bato; ekisa kinaakuuma emyaka gyaffe egiddirira ne kinyweza empisa zaffe ennungi. 5 Gy'oli, Katonda Ayinzabyonna, gy'oli obwana bwaffe tubuwaayo; kinaatusanyusa okutunula emabega ne tulaba nti obulamu bwaffe bwonna bwali bubwo. 6 Omulimu omuwoomerera ogw'okusaba n'okutendereza, gukozese omukka gwange ogusooka; bwe ntyo neetegeka olw'ennaku empanvu, oba ne nsaanira okufa nga nkyali muto. Akabi k'Okulwawo 1 Lwaki njogera nti, “Kikyali kyangu nnyo “okunoonya eggulu oba okulowooza ku kufa?” Ekimuli kiyinza okuwotoka nga essaawa ez'omu ttuntu tezinnatuuka, nange leero nnyinza okufiirwa omukka gwange. 2 Omutima guno ogwange omujeemu, bwe gunyooma okuyita okw'ekisa okw'Eggulu; nnyinza okukakanyala mu kibi kyange, ne siweebwa kwenenya n'akatono. 3 Singa Mukama asunguwala, n'alayira nga nnyanukola okusoma n'okusaba, nti anaagaana okuwuliriza, okusinda kwange kwonna ku lunaku olulala? 4 Singa obusungu bwe obw'entiisa bwaka, nga ngaana ekisa kye ky'awaayo, n'okwagala kwe kwonna ne kufuuka obukambwe, n'ankuba ne nfiira awo? 5 Kya kabi okusunguwaza Katonda; amaanyi ge n'okuwoolera eggwanga tewali ayinza kubyogera: okukuba kumu okw'oluga lwe olw'amaanyi kunaasindika aboonoonyi abato mangu mu muliro. 6 Kale kinaaba kya bwereere emirembe gyonna okukaabira okusonyiyibwa oba okufuna ekisa, okwegomba nti nnandifunye ekiseera kyange nate, oba okusuubira okulaba amaaso g'Omutonzi wange. Eby'okulabirako eby'Okutya Katonda mu Buto 1 Eby'okulabirako ebya mukisa nga bimeka bye nsanga, nga biwandiikiddwa mu Kigambo eky'Amazima, eby'abaana abaatandika okussaayo omwoyo ku ddiini nga bakyali bato. 2 Yesu, afuga waggulu w'eggulu, era akuuma ensi mu ntiisa; yali omwana omuto nga nze, era yakuuma etteeka lya Kitaawe. 3 Ku myaka kkumi n'ebiri yayogera n'abasajja, (Abayudaaya bonna nga bayimirira nga bawuniikiriddwa;) naye n'agondera Nnyina mu kiseera ekyo, n'ajja ku kiragiro kye. 4 Abaana baayimba ozana ewoomerera, ne batendereza erinnya ly'Omulokozi waabwe; baamuwa ekitiibwa n'olulimi lwabwe ng'abawandiisi ne bakabona bavvoola. 5 Samwiri omwana yaggyibwa ku mabeere, n'aleetebwa okuweereza Mukama; Timoseewo omuto yayigirizibwa amangu okumanya Ekigambo kye ekitukuvu. 6 Kale lwaki nnindiriza ekiseera ekiwanvu bwe kityo ekyo abalala kye bayiga amangu? sandiyisizza lunaku lulala nga omulimu guno tegunnatandika.

fields.title: Ennyimba Ezitukuvu, Ekitundu Ekyokubiri
fields.body_html:
Okwewala Obulimba

1 Kya kitiibwa nnyo eri abato
Okutambulira mu kkubo ery'amagezi;
Okutya obulimba, okwogera amazima,
Tulyoke twesigenga byonna bye boogera.

2 Naye abalimba tetuyinza kubeesiga,
Ne bwe bandyogera ekintu ekituufu,
N'oyo akola ensobi emu olubereberye,
N'alimba okugikweka, agifuula bbiri.

3 Tetumanyi, oba tetuwulidde, oba tetusomye,
Katonda nga bw'akyawa obukuusa n'obukyamu?
Ananiya nga bwe yattibwa amangu
Bwe yakwatibwa n'obulimba ku lulimi lwe?

4 Ne mukazi we Safira bw'atyo yafa
Bwe yayingira, n'aba omuvumu ennyo
Okukakasa obulimba obwo obubi
Bba bwe yali yaakayogera.

5 Mukama asanyukira abo aboogera
Ebigambo eby'amazima; naye buli mulimba
Alifuna omugabo gwe mu nnyanja
Eyaka omuliro n'ekibiriiti.

6 Kale nkuumenga bulijjo akamwa kange,
Nneme okuttibwa ne nsuulibwa mu ggeyeena,
Kubanga Katonda alina ekitabo eky'okubala
Ku buli bulimba abaana bwe boogera.

Okwewala Enkaayana n'Entalo

1 Embwa zisanyukire okuboggola n'okuluma,
Kubanga Katonda bwe yazikola;
Eddubu n'empologoma biwulugume birwane,
Kubanga n'obuzaale bwabyo bwe butyo.

2 Naye, abaana, temusaana n'akatono
Okuleka obusungu obwo okubuubuuka;
Emikono gyammwe emitono tegyakolebwa
Kutaagula maaso ga bannammwe.

3 Okwagala kuyite mu bikolwa byammwe byonna,
N'ebigambo byammwe byonna bibe bya bukkakkamu;
Mubeere ng'Omwana w'Omuwala Omulongoofu,
Omwana oyo omuwoomu era omwagalwa.

4 Emmeeme ye yali nnungamu ng'omwana gw'endiga;
Era nga bw'akula mu maaso,
Yeeyongera okusiimibwa abantu,
Ne Katonda Kitaawe.

5 Kaakano, Mukama wa byonna, afugira waggulu,
Era ng'ali ku ntebe ye ey'obwakabaka mu ggulu,
Alaba abaana ababeera mu kwagala,
N'abateeka okuba ababe.

Okwagana kw'Ab'oluganda

1 Ne bwe wabaawo entalo mu nguudo,
Mu maka musaana mubeere emirembe;
Awabeera bannyinaze ne baganda baabwe,
Enkaayana tezisaana kujjayo.

2 Ennyonyi mu bisu byazo entono zikkiriziganya;
Era kya nsonyi okulaba,
Abaana ab'omu maka gamu
Nga baayukana, ne banenyagana, ne balwana.

3 Ebigambo ebikakanyavu okusooka, n'ebigambo eby'okutiisa,
Ebiri bwoyo obuleekaana obwereere,
Biyinza okukula ne bifuuka emiggo n'ebitala,
Ku kutta ne ku kufa.

4 Setaani akema omwana wa nnyina omu
Okusunguwalira munne:
Bw'atyo Kayini omubi bwe yasindikibwa,
Okutuusa lwe yatta muganda we.

5 Ab'amagezi bakkakkanya obusungu bwabwe
Nga obudde tebunnaziba;
Naye mu kifuba ky'omusirusiru
Bwaka okutuusa obudde lwe bukya.

5 Tusonyiwe, ai Mukama, obusungu bwaffe obw'ekyana;
Ggyawo enkaayana zaffe entono;
Bwe tutyo bwe tukula ne tuvubuka,
Emitima gyaffe gyonna gibeere kwagala.

Okwewala Okuduula n'Okuvuma

1 Ennimi zaffe zaakolebwa okutendereza Mukama,
So si okwogera bubi ku bantu:
Abalala bwe batuvuma,
Tetusaana kubaddizaamu kuvuma.

2 Ebigambo eby'obusungu n'okuvuma bisaana
Okukangavvulwa ng'oli ku ssomero;
Era ali mu kabi k'omuliro ogw'omu ggeyeena,
Oyo ayita muganda we, musirusiru.

3 Naye emimwa egivuma ne giyisaamu amaanyi
Okuduula n'okusekerera n'okunyooma
Ebintu ebitukuvu, oba abantu abatukuvu,
Mukama alibasalako.

4 Abaana bwe baali mu muzannyo gwabwe omwonoonefu
Ne bakola bwe batyo Erisa omukadde,
Ne bagamba nnabbi agende ekkubo lye,
“Yambuka, ggwe ow'ekiwalaata, yambuka.”

5 Katonda amangu ago n'aziyiza omukka gwabwe omubi,
N'aweereza eddubu bbiri erisunguwadde,
Ne libataagulataagula okutuusa okufa,
Nga wayiise omusaayi n'okusinda n'amaziga.

6 Ai Katonda Omukulu, nga oli wa ntiisa
Eri aboonoonyi ne bwe baba abato!
Mpa ekisa kyo era onjigirize engeri
Ey'okukkakkanya n'okufuga olulimi lwange.

Okwewala Okulayira, Okukolima, n'Okwogera Erinnya lya Katonda obwereere

1 Bamalayika ababeera waggulu mu kitiibwa
Basinza Erinnya lyo, ai Katonda Ayinzabyonna!
Ne baddayimooni bakankana wansi mu ggeyeena
Wansi w'entiisa y'oluga lwo.

2 Kyokka abaana ababi nga bwe bavumaganya
Erinnya lyo ery'entiisa era ery'ekitiibwa!
Era bwe basunguwala, nga bwe balayira,
Ne bakolimira banne, ne bavvoola!

3 Baliyimirira batya mu maaso go,
Abo abaakunyooma bwe batyo,
Ng'obasalira omusango ne bagenda mu kifo
Eky'omuliro n'obulumi obutaggwaawo?

4 Awo tewaliweebwa tondo n'emu ennyogovu
Ey'okukendeeza ennimi zaabwe eziri mu muliro.
Naye nze nnaakutenderezanga wano, era nga nsuubira
Okukozesa bwe ntyo olulimi lwange mu ggulu.

5 Omutima gwange gulinnuma okuwulira
Abakozi b'ebibi nga bavuma Mukama ali waggulu;
Ye Katonda Omukulu oyo gwe ntya obuyinza bwe,
Kitaffe ali mu ggulu gwe njagala.

6 Bannange bwe bafuuka aboonoonyi,
Nnaaleka omukwano gwabwe bwe mpulira
Aboonoonyi abato nga bavuma erinnya lyo obwereere,
Ne bayiga okukolima, ne bayiga okulayira.

Okwewala Obugayaavu n'Obubi

1 Nga bw'ekola enjuki entono enyiikivu
Ng'ekozesa buli ssaawa evaamu,
Ng'ekuŋŋaanya omubisi olunaku lwonna
Okuva mu buli kimuli ekyanjuluza!

2 Nga bw'ezimba akasenge kaayo n'obukugu!
Nga bw'esiiga obubaati mu ngeri ennungi!
Era ng'ekola nnyo okwetereka obulungi
Emmere ennungi gy'ekola.

3 Mu mirimu egy'amaanyi oba egy'obukugu
Nange nnaabanga munyiikivu:
Kubanga Setaani afunira obubi
Emikono egigayaavu okukola.

4 Mu bitabo, oba mu mirimu, oba mu muzannyo omulamu
Emyaka gyange egy'olubereberye giyiteemu,
Ndyoke buli lunaku mbeere n'eky'okuwaayo
Ekibalo ekirungi ku nkomerero.

Okwewala Emikwano Emibi

1 Lwaki nneegatta n'abo mu muzannyo
Be sisanyukira;
Abakolima ne balayira, naye ne batasaba;
Abavuma, ne balwana?

2 Nkyawa okuwulira oluyimba olw'obwenzi:
Ebigambo byabwe binyiiza amatu gange:
Sisaana kwonoona lulimi lwange
N'ennyogera nga eyaabwe.

3 Nnaakyusa amaaso gange okuva ku basirusiru,
So sijja kutambula na baduuzi:
Nnaatambuliranga n'ab'amagezi,
Ndyoke neeyongere okuba omugezi.

4 Okuva ku mulenzi omu omukambwe, amanyiiridde okuduula,
Bayiga okusaaga okubi:
Endiga emu endwadde eleetera ekisibo obulwadde,
N'ezikiriza endala zonna.

5 Katonda wange, nkyawa okutambula oba okubeera
N'abaana aboonoonyi wano:
Kale toonsindika mu ggeyeena,
Omuli aboonoonyi bokka.

Okwewala Amalala mu Byambalo

1 Lwaki ebyambalo byaffe, ebyakolebwa okubikka
Ku nsonyi za bajjajjaffe, bituleetera amalala?
Obukugu bw'okwambala tebwatandika
Okutuusa Kaawa mmaffe lwe yayiga okwonoona.

2 Bwe yasooka okwambala ekibikka,
Ekyambalo kye eky'obutaliiko musango kyali kigenze;
Kyokka abaana be beenyumiririza obwereere
Mu bubonero obunakuwavu obw'ekitiibwa ekyabula.

3 Nga tuli b'amalala! nga twagala okwolesa
Ebyambalo byaffe, ne tubiyita ebya bbeeyi era ebiggya,
So ng'endiga ennaku n'envunyu za siliki zaabyambala
Ebyambalo ebyo edda ennyo!

4 Ekimuli tulipa n'ekiwojjolo
Byambadde ebyambalo ebisingawo nze obulungi:
Ne bwe nnaayambala obulungi nga bwe njagala,
Ensowera, envunyu, n'ebimuli binsinga bulijjo.

5 Kale nnaateeka omutima gwange okunoonya
Okwewunda okw'omunda okw'omwoyo:
Okumanya n'empisa ennungi, amazima n'ekisa,
Bino bye byambalo eby'omuwendo omungi ennyo.

6 Envunyu tezikyeenkanya nange,
Kino kye kyambalo bamalayika kye bambala:
Omwana wa Katonda, bwe yali wano wansi,
Naye yayambala ekyambalo kino ekiweereddwa omukisa.

6 Tekiggwaamu langi, so tekikaddiwa,
So tekitya nkuba, so biwuka, so bukuku:
Tekifunamu bbala, naye kyeeyongera okulongooka;
Nga bwe kyeyongera okwambalibwa, bwe kityo bwe kyeyongera okwaka.

7 Mu kino nnaalabika ku nsi,
Ne ndyoka ŋŋenda mu ggulu, ne nkyambalira eyo:
Katonda alikisiima mu maaso ge;
Kubanga kye kikolwa kye, era kye kimusanyusa.

Okugondera Abazadde

1 Abaana abaagala okutya Mukama
Bawulire abasomesa baabwe bye boogera;
Batwale n'ekitiibwa ekigambo ky'abazadde baabwe,
Era bagondere n'essanyu.

2 Tomanyi bibonoobono bya ntiisa ki
Mukama by'atiisatiisa,
Eri oyo amenya etteeka lya kitaawe,
Oba anyooma ekigambo kya nnyina?

3 Omusango omuzito nga bwe gumuli ku mutwe!
Nga erinnya lye bwe likolimiddwa!
Namuŋŋoona balisokola amaaso ge,
N'empungu ne zigalya.

4 Naye abo abasinza Katonda, ne bawa
Abazadde baabwe ekitiibwa ekibagwanira,
Wano ku nsi baliwangaala,
Era balibeera balamu ne mu biseera eby'omu maaso.

Okwemulugunya kw'Omwana

1 Lwaki njagala nnyo emizannyo gyange,
Ne mmalira ekiseera mu muzannyo gwange,
Ne nfiirwa okulowooza ku ggulu ne ggeyeena,
Ne nnyoke neerabira okusaba?

2 Nsomera ki Baibuli yange,
Wabula, Mukama, okuyiga by'oyagala?
Kale nkumanye buli lunaku okusingawo,
Ate ne nkugondera okukendeera?

3 Nga omutima gwange bwe gutalina magezi, era omukambwe!
Nga ebirowoozo byange byonna bwe biri eby'obwereere!
Saasira obunafu bw'omwana,
Era osonyiwe ensobi zange zonna.

4 Nkozese okuwulira eddoboozi lyo ery'omu ggulu,
Era leka njagale okusaba;
Kubanga Katonda awuliriza n'ekisa
Ekyo omwana ky'ayinza okwogera.

Oluyimba lwa Makya

1 Katonda wange, afuula enjuba okumanya
Essaawa yaayo entuufu ey'okuvaayo;
Era, okumulisa byonna ebiri wansi,
Agitwala okwetooloola eggulu:

2 Bw'eva mu bisenge eby'ebuvanjuba
N'etandika okudduka kwayo okw'oku makya,
Tekoowa, so tekoma kuwummula,
Naye eyaka okwetooloola ensi yonna.

3 Bwe ntyo, ng'enjuba, nnaatuukiriza
Emirimu egy'olunaku;
Ntandike omulimu gwange amangu, era buli kiseera
Ne ntambula mu kkubo lyange ery'omu ggulu.

4 Mpa, ai Mukama, ekisa kyo eky'oku makya,
So toleka mmeeme yange kwemulugunya
Nti amakya g'olunaku lwange
Gonna gamaliddwa bwereere!

Oluyimba lwa Kawungeezi

1 Kaakano olunaku olulala luweddeewo,
Nnaayimba nnyimbe okutendereza Omutonzi wange!
Ebimpummuza buli ssaawa biraga
Okulabirira kwe n'ekisa kye.

2 Naye nga obwana bwange bwe bufiirwa,
Ebibi byange nga omuwendo gwabyo bwe guli munene!
Mukama, mpa okusonyiyibwa olw'ebyayita,
N'amaanyi olw'ennaku ezijja.

3 Ngalamiza omubiri gwange okwebaka,
Bamalayika bakuume omutwe gwange;
Era, mu ssaawa ez'ekizikiza, bakuume
Nga bankuuma nga banneetoolodde.

4 N'omutima omusanyufu nzibiriza amaaso gange,
Kubanga tojja kunvaako;
Era enkya onzuukuse
Nga nsanyukira mu kwagala kwo.

Ku Makya g'Olunaku lwa Mukama

1 Luno lwe lunaku Kristo lwe yazuukira
Ku makya ennyo okuva mu bafu:
Lwaki nzibe ebikowe byange,
Ne mmalira essaawa zange mu kitanda?

2 Luno lwe lunaku Yesu lwe yamenya
Amaanyi g'okufa n'ag'omu ggeyeena;
Kale nkyambale ekikoligo kya Setaani,
Ne njagala ebibi byange bwe ntyo?

3 Leero, n'essanyu, Abakristaayo basisinkana,
Okusaba, n'okuwulira Ekigambo kyo;
Nange nnaagenda n'ebigere ebisanyufu
Okuyiga by'oyagala, ai Mukama!

4 Nnaaleka omuzannyo gwange, okusoma n'okusaba,
Bwe ntyo neetegekere eggulu:
Ai nsaba njagale olunaku luno oluweereddwa omukisa
Olusinga ennaku omusanvu zonna!

Ku Kawungeezi w'Olunaku lwa Mukama

1 Mukama, nga kya ssanyu okulaba
Ekibiina kyonna nga kikusinza!
Bayimba wamu, era basaba wamu;
Bawulira ku ggulu, ne bayiga ekkubo.

2 Nabaddeyo, era nkyagala okugenda
Kiri ng'akatundu k'eggulu wano wansi!
Essanyu lyange lyonna n'omuzannyo gwange
Tebisaana kunkema kwerabira lunaku luno.

3 Ai wandiika ku kujjukira kwange, Mukama,
Ebyawandiikibwa n'enjigiriza y'Ekigambo kyo,
Ndyoke nneme okwongera okumenya amateeka go,
Naye nkwagale okusinga bwe nnali edda!

4 N'ebirowoozo bya Kristo n'ebintu ebya Katonda
Jjuza omutima guno ogwange ogusirusiru:
Nga, nsuubira okusonyiyibwa olw'omusaayi gwe,
Ndyoke ngalamire, ne nzuukuka ne Katonda.

AMATEEKA EKKUMI agava mu Ndagaano Enkadde agateekeddwa mu
byevvugo ebimpi olw'abaana.

Kuv. 20.

1. Tobeeranga na bakatonda balala wabula nze. 2. Tovuunamiranga kifaananyi kyonna. 3. Toyogeranga Erinnya lya Katonda obwereere: 4. So tovumisanga Olunaku lwa Ssabbiiti. 5. Wanga abazadde bo bombi ekitiibwa ekibagwanira. 6. Weekuume oleme okutta. 7. Weewale ebigambo n'ebikolwa ebitali birongoofu: 8. So tobbanga, ne bw'oba omwavu era atalina kantu. 9. So tolimbanga mu bugenderevu, so tokwagalanga kulimba. 10. Ekya muliraanwa wo, toluubirira.

Ensonga Enkulu ey'Amateeka agava mu Ndagaano Empya.

Mat. 22. 37.

N'emmeeme yo yonna yagala Katonda ali waggulu;
Era yagala muliraanwa wo nga bwe weeyagala wekka.

Etteeka lya Zaabu ery'Omulokozi waffe.

Mat. 7. 12.

Beeranga wa kisa era ow'amazima eri abalala,
Nga bw'oyagala abalala babeere gy'oli.
So tokolanga wadde okwogera eri abantu
Kyonna ky'otoyagala kukolebwa gy'oli.

Obuvunaanyizibwa eri Katonda n'eri muliraanwa waffe.

Yagala Katonda n'emmeeme yo yonna n'amaanyi go gonna,
N'omutima gwo gwonna n'amagezi go;
Era yagala muliraanwa wo nga bwe weeyagala wekka:
Beeranga mwesigwa, ow'obwenkanya, era ow'ekisa.

Yisanga omulala nga bw'oyagala
Omulala akuyise ggwe.
Ekyo ky'otoyagala kufuna,
Weegendereze oleme kukikola.

Okuva mu Kitabo kyange eky'Ennyimba, wano nnyongeddeko, Hosana ne Ekitiibwa kibe eri Kitaffe, n'ebirala, ebinaayimbibwanga ku nkomerero ya buli lumu ku nnyimba zino, ng'okulagira kw'abazadde oba abakulembeze bwe kuli.

Ekya Hosana; oba Obulokozi obuweebwa Kristo.

Ekigero Ekiwanvu.

1 Hosana eri Omwana wa kabaka Dawudi,
Afugira ku ntebe ey'ekitiibwa ekisingayo;
Tutendereza Omulangira eyazaalibwa mu ggulu,
Aleeta Obulokozi wansi ku nsi.

2 Buli ggwanga, buli mulembe,
Byeenyigire mu mulimu guno ogusanyusa;
Abasajja abakadde n'abaana abato mu Sayuuni bayimbe
Ekitiibwa kya Kabaka waabwe ekyeyongera!

Ekigero Ekya Bulijjo.

1 Hosana eri Omulangira ow'Ekisa; Sayuuni laba Kabaka wo; Langirira Omwana ow'omu lulyo lwa Dawudi, era yigiriza abaana abato okuyimba.

2 Hosana eri Ekigambo Eky'olubeerera,
Ekyava eri Kitaffe;
Muwe Mukama Obulokozi,
N'emikisa ku Linnya lye!

Ekigero Ekimpi.

1 Hosana eri Omwana
Owa Dawudi era owa Katonda,
Eyaleeta Amawulire ag'okusonyiyibwa wansi,
N'agagula n'Omusaayi gwe.

2 Eri Kristo, Kabaka eyafukibwako amafuta,
Waweebwe emikisa egitaggwaawo,
Ensi yonna eyimbe Ekitiibwa kye
Eyatuteekera Emirembe n'Eggulu.

Ekitiibwa kibe eri Kitaffe n'Omwana, n'ebirala.

Ekigero Ekiwanvu.

Eri Katonda Kitaffe, Katonda Omwana,
Ne Katonda Omwoyo, Abasatu mu Omu,
Waweebwe Ekitiibwa, Okutendereza, n'Obukulu,
Bonna abali ku Nsi, ne bonna abali mu Ggulu.

Ekigero Ekya Bulijjo.

Kaakano Kitaffe n'Omwana,
N'Omwoyo basinzibwe,
Awali ebikolwa ebimumanyisa,
Oba abatukuvu abaagala Mukama.

Ekigero Ekimpi.

Mutendereze Kitaffe,
Muwe Omwana Ekitiibwa,
N'Omwoyo ow'Ekisa kye
Aweebwe ekitiibwa kye kimu.

Oluyimba lwa Makya 1 Katonda wange, afuula enjuba okumanya Essaawa yaayo entuufu ey'okuvaayo; Era, okumulisa byonna ebiri wansi, Agitwala okwetooloola eggulu: 2 Bw'eva mu bisenge eby'ebuvanjuba N'etandika okudduka kwayo okw'oku makya, Tekoowa, so tekoma kuwummula, Naye eyaka okwetooloola ensi yonna. 3 Bwe ntyo, ng'enjuba, nnaatuukiriza Emirimu egy'olunaku; Ntandike omulimu gwange amangu, era buli kiseera Ne ntambula mu kkubo lyange ery'omu ggulu. 4 Mpa, ai Mukama, ekisa kyo eky'oku makya, So toleka mmeeme yange kwemulugunya Nti amakya g'olunaku lwange Gonna gamaliddwa bwereere! Oluyimba lwa Kawungeezi 1 Kaakano olunaku olulala luweddeewo, Nnaayimba nnyimbe okutendereza Omutonzi wange! Ebimpummuza buli ssaawa biraga Okulabirira kwe n'ekisa kye. 2 Naye nga obwana bwange bwe bufiirwa, Ebibi byange nga omuwendo gwabyo bwe guli munene! Mukama, mpa okusonyiyibwa olw'ebyayita, N'amaanyi olw'ennaku ezijja. 3 Ngalamiza omubiri gwange okwebaka, Bamalayika bakuume omutwe gwange; Era, mu ssaawa ez'ekizikiza, bakuume Nga bankuuma nga banneetoolodde. 4 N'omutima omusanyufu nzibiriza amaaso gange, Kubanga tojja kunvaako; Era enkya onzuukuse Nga nsanyukira mu kwagala kwo. Ku Makya g'Olunaku lwa Mukama 1 Luno lwe lunaku Kristo lwe yazuukira Ku makya ennyo okuva mu bafu: Lwaki nzibe ebikowe byange, Ne mmalira essaawa zange mu kitanda? 2 Luno lwe lunaku Yesu lwe yamenya Amaanyi g'okufa n'ag'omu ggeyeena; Kale nkyambale ekikoligo kya Setaani, Ne njagala ebibi byange bwe ntyo? 3 Leero, n'essanyu, Abakristaayo basisinkana, Okusaba, n'okuwulira Ekigambo kyo; Nange nnaagenda n'ebigere ebisanyufu Okuyiga by'oyagala, ai Mukama! 4 Nnaaleka omuzannyo gwange, okusoma n'okusaba, Bwe ntyo neetegekere eggulu: Ai nsaba njagale olunaku luno oluweereddwa omukisa Olusinga ennaku omusanvu zonna! Ku Kawungeezi w'Olunaku lwa Mukama 1 Mukama, nga kya ssanyu okulaba Ekibiina kyonna nga kikusinza! Bayimba wamu, era basaba wamu; Bawulira ku ggulu, ne bayiga ekkubo. 2 Nabaddeyo, era nkyagala okugenda Kiri ng'akatundu k'eggulu wano wansi! Essanyu lyange lyonna n'omuzannyo gwange Tebisaana kunkema kwerabira lunaku luno. 3 Ai wandiika ku kujjukira kwange, Mukama, Ebyawandiikibwa n'enjigiriza y'Ekigambo kyo, Ndyoke nneme okwongera okumenya amateeka go, Naye nkwagale okusinga bwe nnali edda! 4 N'ebirowoozo bya Kristo n'ebintu ebya Katonda Jjuza omutima guno ogwange ogusirusiru: Nga, nsuubira okusonyiyibwa olw'omusaayi gwe, Ndyoke ngalamire, ne nzuukuka ne Katonda. AMATEEKA EKKUMI agava mu Ndagaano Enkadde agateekeddwa mu byevvugo ebimpi olw'abaana. Kuv. 20. 1. Tobeeranga na bakatonda balala wabula nze. 2. Tovuunamiranga kifaananyi kyonna. 3. Toyogeranga Erinnya lya Katonda obwereere: 4. So tovumisanga Olunaku lwa Ssabbiiti. 5. Wanga abazadde bo bombi ekitiibwa ekibagwanira. 6. Weekuume oleme okutta. 7. Weewale ebigambo n'ebikolwa ebitali birongoofu: 8. So tobbanga, ne bw'oba omwavu era atalina kantu. 9. So tolimbanga mu bugenderevu, so tokwagalanga kulimba. 10. Ekya muliraanwa wo, toluubirira. Ensonga Enkulu ey'Amateeka agava mu Ndagaano Empya. Mat. 22. 37. N'emmeeme yo yonna yagala Katonda ali waggulu; Era yagala muliraanwa wo nga bwe weeyagala wekka. Etteeka lya Zaabu ery'Omulokozi waffe. Mat. 7. 12. Beeranga wa kisa era ow'amazima eri abalala, Nga bw'oyagala abalala babeere gy'oli. So tokolanga wadde okwogera eri abantu Kyonna ky'otoyagala kukolebwa gy'oli. Obuvunaanyizibwa eri Katonda n'eri muliraanwa waffe. Yagala Katonda n'emmeeme yo yonna n'amaanyi go gonna, N'omutima gwo gwonna n'amagezi go; Era yagala muliraanwa wo nga bwe weeyagala wekka: Beeranga mwesigwa, ow'obwenkanya, era ow'ekisa. Yisanga omulala nga bw'oyagala Omulala akuyise ggwe. Ekyo ky'otoyagala kufuna, Weegendereze oleme kukikola. Okuva mu Kitabo kyange eky'Ennyimba, wano nnyongeddeko, Hosana ne Ekitiibwa kibe eri Kitaffe, n'ebirala, ebinaayimbibwanga ku nkomerero ya buli lumu ku nnyimba zino, ng'okulagira kw'abazadde oba abakulembeze bwe kuli. Ekya Hosana; oba Obulokozi obuweebwa Kristo. Ekigero Ekiwanvu. 1 Hosana eri Omwana wa kabaka Dawudi, Afugira ku ntebe ey'ekitiibwa ekisingayo; Tutendereza Omulangira eyazaalibwa mu ggulu, Aleeta Obulokozi wansi ku nsi. 2 Buli ggwanga, buli mulembe, Byeenyigire mu mulimu guno ogusanyusa; Abasajja abakadde n'abaana abato mu Sayuuni bayimbe Ekitiibwa kya Kabaka waabwe ekyeyongera! Ekigero Ekya Bulijjo. 1 Hosana eri Omulangira ow'Ekisa; Sayuuni laba Kabaka wo; Langirira Omwana ow'omu lulyo lwa Dawudi, era yigiriza abaana abato okuyimba. 2 Hosana eri Ekigambo Eky'olubeerera, Ekyava eri Kitaffe; Muwe Mukama Obulokozi, N'emikisa ku Linnya lye! Ekigero Ekimpi. 1 Hosana eri Omwana Owa Dawudi era owa Katonda, Eyaleeta Amawulire ag'okusonyiyibwa wansi, N'agagula n'Omusaayi gwe. 2 Eri Kristo, Kabaka eyafukibwako amafuta, Waweebwe emikisa egitaggwaawo, Ensi yonna eyimbe Ekitiibwa kye Eyatuteekera Emirembe n'Eggulu. Ekitiibwa kibe eri Kitaffe n'Omwana, n'ebirala. Ekigero Ekiwanvu. Eri Katonda Kitaffe, Katonda Omwana, Ne Katonda Omwoyo, Abasatu mu Omu, Waweebwe Ekitiibwa, Okutendereza, n'Obukulu, Bonna abali ku Nsi, ne bonna abali mu Ggulu. Ekigero Ekya Bulijjo. Kaakano Kitaffe n'Omwana, N'Omwoyo basinzibwe, Awali ebikolwa ebimumanyisa, Oba abatukuvu abaagala Mukama. Ekigero Ekimpi. Mutendereze Kitaffe, Muwe Omwana Ekitiibwa, N'Omwoyo ow'Ekisa kye Aweebwe ekitiibwa kye kimu.

fields.title: Ennyimba Bbiri ez'Empisa
fields.body_html:
Omugayaavu

1 Eddoboozi ery'omugayaavu; namuwulira ng'eemulugunya
“Munzuukusizza mangu nnyo! Nteekwa okwongera okwebaka!”
Ng'oluggi bwe lukyukira ku nfulu zaalwo, bw'atyo ku kitanda kye,
Akyusa embiriizi ze, n'ebibegabega bye, n'omutwe gwe omuzito.

2 “Otulo otutono nate, n'okusumagira okutono nate;”
Bw'atyo ayonoona ekitundu ky'ennaku ze, n'essaawa ze ezitabalika:
Era bw'agolokoka, atuula ng'awetye emikono gye
Oba atambulatambula obutaliimu, oba ayimirira awo obwereere.

3 Nayita ku nnimiro ye, ne ndaba amaggwa ag'omu nsiko
Amaggwa n'omwennyango nga bigaziwa era nga bikula waggulu:
Engoye z'ayambadde nga zifuuka bitanko;
N'ensimbi ze nga ziweddewo, era alumwa enjala, oba asaba.

4 Namukyalira, nga nkyasuubira okulaba
Nga yeefaako okulongoosa amagezi ge:
Yambuulira ebirooto bye, n'ayogera ku kulya n'okunywa,
Naye tasoma Bayibuli ye n'akatono, era tayagala kulowooza.

5 Awo ne ŋŋamba omutima gwange nti, “Lino lye ssomo gye ndi,”
Omuntu oyo kifaananyi bukifaananyi kya kye nnandibadde:
Naye nsiima mikwano gyange olw'okundabirira mu kukula kwange:
Abanjigiriza nga nkyali muto okwagala okukola n'okusoma!

Okuzannya Okutaliiko Kabi

1 Ebweru mu ddundiro okulaba abaana b'endiga,
Nga baddukana nga bazannya ku mabbali ga bannyaabwe
Nga bali n'ebyoya ebiyonjo, era ebyeru nnyo;
Oba akasu k'amayiba amato mu kkomera eddene erigguddwa,
Bwe bazannya bonna mu kwagala awatali busungu oba obukambwe,
Nga tuyinza okuyiga kungi okuva mu kulaba okwo!

2 Singa twali mbaata, twandinnyididde mu bitosi:
Oba embwa, twandizannye okutuusa lwe kiggwa mu musaayi;
Obutonde bwabyo bwe buli obucaafu, oba obukambwe.
Naye Tomasi ne Wiriamu, n'amannya amalungi ng'ago,
Basaanidde okuba abayonjo n'abatalina kabi ng'amayiba, oba ng'abaana b'endiga,
Ebitonde ebyo ebyagalwa, ebiwoomu, ebitaliiko musango.

3 Tewali kintu kye tukola, newaakubadde ekigambo kye twogera,
Ekisaana okulumya munnaffe mu kusaaga oba mu kuzannya;
Kubanga oyo alumizibwa aba mu bulumi ddala.
Abalenzi abakanyuga amayinja n'ebitosi nga tebalina mpisa!
Tewali okuggyako omulalu ayinza okusuula omuliro,
N'akugamba nti, “Byonna kuzannya buzannyi kwokka.”
